scope: Selected MoveToCover completion, hold, return and cleanup branches. Not a complete FSM or source-tree review. Some long inspection outputs were truncated; no full-file review credit.

dispositions.intent: Retain useful cover while suppressed; distinguish reached, nearby and failed movement.
dispositions.observed: Reached cover forceSpeed0; nominal hold is capped15 seconds, but timeout requires suppression at or below skill for reached ordinary cover. Defensive reached cover has a separate leave predicate.
dispositions.decision: Retain suppression-sensitive tactical intent, but do not import an unbounded speed hold. CBE danger cover currently releases its finite movement marker on arrival without adding a forced hold.
dispositions.remaining: Trace CBE suppression and defensive-position owners before deciding whether a finite tactical hold is missing; no new controller is justified by this selected comparison alone.

dispositions.intent: Resume original movement when cover episode ends, while yielding to medical ownership.
dispositions.observed: Return branch compares waypoint indices and can issue doMove to saved GoPos if cycle and eligibility match.
dispositions.decision: Do not equate unchanged waypoint index with unchanged mission authority. CBE uses original route receipt, operation/epoch and actor goal checks; failed-approach return now retains the original formation anchor.

dispositions.intent: Reject stale episode cleanup and release movement/targeting modifications.
dispositions.observed: Cycle guard protects many writes, but cleanup resets forceSpeed and enables targeting/suppression/autocombat features rather than restoring individual saved feature baselines.
dispositions.decision: Retain episode identity and single cleanup ownership; do not import unconditional feature enablement or remembered-target replay over newer authority.
dispositions.remaining: Review all selected CBE cover/stance/target writers together before extending restoration. No runtime changes made by this review.

dispositions.observed: After repeated missing destinations, chooses a random position near leader.
dispositions.decision: Do not call an arbitrary fallback point cover. Required safe fallback remains subject to geometry, reachability and mission authority; failure may retire the finite attempt.

nextWork: Complete untruncated startup/move/cleanup inspection and actual callers, then compare suppression/defence ownership across CBE before selecting further runtime changes. Do not repeat the already committed anchor fix.

ranges: 1841-1930: defensive assignment, doFSM dispatch and subsequent buddy writes
callerTrace.limits: Selected caller regions only. Whole findCover function and buddy lifecycle not fully reviewed. Source startup/move and nil-exit blocks were read with quoted FSM strings decoded as text, never executed.

cbeFinding.issue: DangerSetup explicit cleanup invoked cover helper in normal service mode before generation invalidation. A still-enabled current cover lease could be retained rather than retired.
cbeFinding.fix: Pass existing releaseOnly=true. Existing helper then suppresses adoption, retention and failed-approach follow, removes only exact owned movement metadata, and retires matching pending assessment. No movement cancellation/teleport/AI-feature writes added.

cbeComposition.callSites: CortexGroupTick services active response or original cover lease; DangerSetup and CortexReleaseGroup release posture and movement through their existing helpers.
cbeComposition.posture: At most64 sampled members and4 eligible idle actors. Weak posture only; no forceSpeed, target, firing or route writes. Actor release before cover/indoor movement restores only unchanged generation/epoch/operation-owned stance, otherwise refuses or transfers unchanged proof to existing finite actor cleanup.
cbeComposition.decision: Do not duplicate posture with a forced-speed cover hold. Useful cover arrival remains movement-free; dedicated tactical defence and source position-selection semantics remain separate review work.
cbeComposition.limits: This establishes code composition, not adequate tactical holding, physically effective cover, complete interruption correctness, whole-source parity or measured cost.

findings: Source gathers structural and terrain candidates once rather than repeating nearest-object searches per grid cell.
Source distinguishes defensive-slot selection and overwatch preference; only a top-six shortlist gets the extra firing LOS check. LOS is a preference, not a safety requirement.
CBE CortexFindCover merges terrain and placed structures before its ten-object geometry budget; validates occupancy/slope/space, screens at chest height, then accepts the first valid candidate.

CBE CortexCoverScreened distinguishes FIRE/GEOM from VIEW screening, excludes human bodies, caps returned surfaces at4 and does not establish path accessibility or resistance to a particular munition.
selectedPositionReview.disposition: Keep emergency refuge selection separate from firing-position/overwatch scoring. Do not make exposure LOS a mandatory condition for refuge or add source grid/role searches to every danger callback. Reconcile firing-position quality through its existing tactical owner.
gaps: Selected cover source admits placed Fence and other resolved fortification classes absent from the narrow CBE placed query; engine hierarchy/applicability and physical screening must be verified before broadening it.
Whole source position generation, defensive-object resolver, scoring and fallback traversal remain unreviewed.
No evidence yet establishes equivalent overwatch and defensive-slot quality.

intent: Blend personal/group/peak pressure; closest-safe mode at high pressure rather than advancing for score.
Hard per-actor maximum cover distance; support/overwatch destination cohesion and straggler recovery.
Protection/road/open-ground/distance scores; retreat gain for broken actors and pressure-dependent forward gain otherwise.
Base-of-fire/overwatch lag and standoff preferences; stronger cohesion gain when recovering.

sourceDefect.finding: Cohesion rejection exitWith is inside the role-cohesion then block. The enclosing scoreCandidate continues through threat/protection/role scoring afterward, so the branch return does not establish the documented hard rejection at function scope.
sourceDefect.confidence: Static SQF scope finding; source was not executed.
sourceDefect.disposition: Do not import this control flow. Any selected hard cohesion policy must reject at the scoring function scope before ranking, with an existing regression check covering both inside-leash escape and outside-leash non-recovery.

selectedScoringReview.integrationDecision: Do not place role scoring in the emergency cover reflex. Reconcile through existing finite tactical/flank actors; preserve per-actor travel, pressure and cohesion hard gates before optional preference scoring. No new global pressure service or repeated world queries.
selectedScoringReview.remaining: Actual CBE tactical-role scoring equivalence has not been established; source helper dependencies and candidate construction still need complete review.

cbeTacticalFollowup.finding: Flank bound slot preparation tried three reduced lateral terrain alternatives but, when all failed, retained and issued the original water/steep-slope point.
cbeTacticalFollowup.implementation: Newly planned slots must pass the existing water/slope criterion after alternatives, before the native commit. Otherwise terminate through existing drill cleanup with NO_SAFE_BOUND_TERRAIN. Original resumed destinations are not resampled. No search expansion, retry, worker or deadline renewal.
cbeTacticalFollowup.cost: At most one additional water/slope classification per newly planned actor slot; physical cost unmeasured.
cbeTacticalFollowup.limits: Terrain classification is not path reachability. Refusal ends the current drill rather than finding a global alternative; tactical replanning and physical behaviour remain unverified.
